articles.summary: Under Armour welcomes Cincinnati Bengals wide receiver Tee Higgins as the newest addition to its football roster. As an Under Armour athlete, Higgins will represent the brand on and off the field, showcasing Under Armour footwear, apparel and accessories. He will also be featured in marketing initiatives, including future extensions of Under Armour's WE LOVE FOOTBALL series.
articles.title: Under Armour Welcomes NFL Star Tee Higgins to its Football Roster
